**On two approaches to 3-dimensional TQFTs**

*VLADIMIR TURAEV AND ALEXIS VIRELIZIER*

72 pp, 19 sections.

**Abstract.** W e prove that|M |C = τZ(C)(M ) for any closed oriented 3-manifold M and for any spherical fusion category C of non-zero dimension. Here |M |C is the Turaev-Viro-Barrett-W estbury state sum invariant of M derived from C, Z(C) is the Drinfeld-Joyal-Street center of C, and τZ(C)(M ) is the Reshetikhin- Turaev surgery invariant of M derived from Z(C).

**Outline.** Front matter; Introduction; 1 Pivotal and spherical categories; 2 Multiplicities in pivotal categories; 3 Invariants of colored graphs; 4 Pre-fusion and fusion categories; 5 State sums on triangulated 3-manifolds; 6 State sums on skeletons of 3-manifolds; 7 Moves on skeletons and proof of Theorems 5.1; 8 Skeletons in the relative case; 9 The state-sum TQFT; 10 Modular categories and categorical centers; 11 Main theorems and applications; 12 State sum invariants of links in 3-manifold; 13 Deduction of Theorems 11.1 and 11.2 from Le; 14 The coend of the center; 15 Proof of Lemma 11.3; Appendix.
